releases.title: A steadier Ball Boy opening and clearer next-match copy
releases.titleZh: Ball Boy 打开更稳定，下一场比赛文案更清晰
highlights: Ball Boy now opens as one coordinated surface: the panel, title, header controls, and conversation share the same reveal timing, while the composer appears without an extra delay.
On small screens, the footer disclaimer keeps its collision-safe wrap and spacing while Ball Boy opens or closes instead of shifting during the animation.
Rest-day guidance now presents the next match as a normal sentence with standard spacing around the flags, team names, and versus text while keeping every item vertically aligned.
On small screens, the Report issue source tooltip now keeps extra breathing room from the viewport edge across browser font and layout differences.
On rest days, hiding Recent matches now applies the same desktop spacing adjustment as match days, so the Today empty state stays aligned with the normal schedule layout.
highlightsZh: Ball Boy 现在会作为一个协调一致的界面打开：面板、标题、顶部控件和对话区采用相同的显示时机，输入框不再额外延迟出现。
在小屏幕上，Ball Boy 打开或关闭时，页脚免责声明会保持避让吉祥物后的换行和间距，不再随着动画移动。
无比赛日的提示现在会以普通句子展示下一场比赛，国旗、球队名称和对阵文字之间使用标准间距，同时保持各元素垂直对齐。
在小屏幕上，“报告问题”页面的来源提示会在不同浏览器字体和布局下与视口边缘保持更充足的留白。
在无比赛日隐藏“最近比赛”后，桌面端会采用与比赛日相同的间距调整，让“今天”的空状态与常规赛程布局保持对齐。

releases.title: Spanish and Korean, faster history browsing, and polished controls
releases.titleZh: 新增西班牙语与韩语、更快的历史记录浏览及更完善的操作控件
highlights: Spanish (Latin America) and Korean now cover the full app, including matches, standings, tournament paths, search, Catch Up, player and coach cards, country views, past and future World Cups, Ball Boy, Report issue, and release notes.

Language packs load only when selected and reuse structured football templates for current and historical content, keeping English visits unchanged and first-switch transfers to about 90 KB for Spanish and 119 KB for Korean.
Player names follow broadcast conventions: familiar official spellings in Spanish and sourced Korean newsroom names, with all 4,052 current and historical player records covered.
All 2,826 historical result recaps, 209 archive venues, and 104 current head-to-head summaries now use reviewed structured locale formatters instead of runtime machine translation.

Third-place and final probable line-ups now combine same-day independent previews with official FIFA history; France vs England's confirmed forecast also replaces the earlier scenario model with a fresh 50/25/25 regulation consensus from direct Betfair and bet365 prices.
Clarity analytics now runs only on the canonical production host, keeping local and automated locale checks lighter and isolated from third-party script errors without changing production tracking.

See or hide previous World Cups now updates the existing country-search view instead of rebuilding every result, making loaded archives feel immediate while Spanish and Korean cold loads show an accessible busy indicator.

Tournament round headings now work as keyboard-accessible jump controls that spotlight the first match in that round. Selected match rows use one flat highlight color and extend their rounded shape evenly on both sides at standard phone and desktop widths, protect ultra-narrow live rows from overflow, and keep score pills aligned to the shared right edge when team names wrap. Today and Yesterday calendar shortcuts also use a softer text weight.
On small screens, the collapsed Ball Boy mascot now gives footer copy a curved exclusion area so source, release-note, and report links remain readable and tappable.
Ball Boy player answers now open with a short localized introduction naming the player before the card, giving shorthand searches and follow-up details a more natural conversational handoff.

The Report issue page now has localized Settings for language, dark mode, and returning home, with tighter spacing and the same state carried back to the main app. Report issue has moved out of the main Settings panel and into Ball Boy as a fourth starter action and the first recovery option when a question is not understood.

Settings now uses a searchable, keyboard-accessible time-zone picker with localized city names, abbreviations, UTC offsets, recent and popular choices, and a mobile bottom sheet. Choosing Default follows the device time zone on future visits instead of freezing the current city.

Rest days remain selectable in the calendar: Yesterday is enabled only when that day has a match, while an empty Today shows the next match date and teams plus a Go to up next action that opens the correct day and match. On mobile, that action uses a compact capsule while retaining a full 44-pixel touch target.

Ball Boy now introduces the Report issue form before showing its button, recognizes top player questions like key player requests, and uses a calmer translucent conversation surface; report submissions also omit the redundant time-zone field.
highlightsZh: 拉丁美洲西班牙语和韩语现已覆盖整个应用，包括比赛、积分榜、淘汰赛路径、搜索、“追上进度”、球员与教练卡片、国家队视图、往届与未来世界杯、Ball Boy、“报告问题”和发布说明。
语言包只会在用户选择后加载，并为当前与历史内容复用结构化足球模板；英语访问的加载量保持不变，首次切换约需传输90 KB的西班牙语资源或119 KB的韩语资源。
球员姓名遵循电视转播惯例：西班牙语采用熟悉的官方拼写，韩语采用有来源依据的新闻编辑室常用姓名，现役与历史共4,052条球员记录已全部覆盖。
全部2,826条历史赛果回顾、209个往届赛事场地和104条当前交锋摘要现已采用经审核的结构化本地化格式器，不再依赖运行时机器翻译。
季军赛与决赛的预计阵容现会结合比赛当天的独立前瞻和FIFA官方历史资料；法国对英格兰的已确认预测也已用Betfair与bet365的直接赔率更新为50/25/25常规时间综合预测，取代先前的情景模型。
Clarity分析现在只会在正式生产域名上运行，让本地与自动化语言检查更轻量，并与第三方脚本错误隔离，同时不改变生产环境中的统计。
在国家队搜索中显示或隐藏往届世界杯时，现在会直接更新现有视图，不再重建全部结果；已加载的历史记录几乎会立即响应，而西班牙语和韩语首次加载时会显示支持无障碍的忙碌状态。
赛事轮次标题现在可通过键盘操作，并能直接聚焦该轮首场比赛。选中的比赛行会采用单一平坦的高亮颜色，并在常规手机和桌面宽度下让圆角形状向两侧均匀延伸，同时在极窄的实时比赛行中避免溢出；球队名称换行时，比分胶囊仍会对齐到统一的右侧边缘。“今天”和“昨天”日历快捷按钮的字重也更柔和。
在小屏幕上，收起状态的 Ball Boy 吉祥物会为页脚文字留出弧形空间，让来源、发布说明和问题报告链接保持清晰且可点击。
Ball Boy 的球员回答现在会在卡片前先用本地化的简短句子点名球员，让简写搜索和后续资料之间的对话衔接更自然。
“报告问题”页面现在提供本地化设置，可切换语言、深色模式并返回首页，同时采用更紧凑的间距并把状态带回主应用。“报告问题”已从主设置面板移至 Ball Boy，作为第四个初始操作，并在无法理解问题时优先提供。
设置中的时区选择现已升级为可搜索且支持键盘操作的选择器，提供本地化城市名称、缩写、UTC 偏移、最近使用与常用选项，并在移动端以底部面板显示。选择“默认”后，今后访问时会继续跟随设备时区，而不会固定在当前城市。
日历中的无比赛日仍可选择：只有昨天有比赛时“昨天”按钮才会启用；当天无比赛时会显示下一场比赛的日期与双方球队，并提供“前往下一场比赛”操作，直接打开正确的日期和比赛。移动端会以更紧凑的胶囊样式显示该操作，同时保留完整的44像素触控区域。
Ball Boy 现在会先介绍“报告问题”表单，再显示操作按钮；询问“顶尖球员”时会按“关键球员”请求处理，对话界面也采用更平静的半透明表面。问题报告提交内容同时移除了重复的时区字段。

releases.title: Clearer tooltips, smoother match selection, and stronger football visuals
releases.titleZh: 提示信息更清晰、比赛选择更顺畅、足球视觉更稳健
highlights: Info tooltips inside the desktop match-detail scroll card now detect vertical clipping and open below their trigger when there is not enough room above, while preserving the normal upward placement when space allows.

Jarell Quansah's suspended bench row now keeps the status in its accessibility label and red-card tooltip instead of repeating “Suspended” inside the pill; the long explanation wraps cleanly, stays within the viewport, and opens from keyboard focus even on touch-capable devices.
Compact country-search results now smoothly scroll to the selected match details, while reduced-motion mode keeps the transition instant.
Dark-mode substitution pills now stay fully opaque after revealing the incoming player, preventing the portrait underneath from bleeding through.
Ball Boy match scoreboards keep both team flags fully opaque; winner and loser emphasis now changes only the team-name text.

All 102 completed tournament line-ups have now been audited match by match and saved with permanent exact placement: 42 use FIFA tactical documents, 17 use unanimous exact-source agreement, 34 use a strict source majority, and 9 individually reviewed ties preserve their evidence.

Player-card photos now use a face-biased crop that keeps unusually tall portraits visible on desktop and mobile; the image audit covered all 1,248 current-player dimensions, face-checked 446 portraits, and adds a browser regression check for the crop position.

England's expanded semi-final bench still counts only its 14 eligible substitutes, then shows Jarell Quansah as an additional greyed-out suspended player without making him available for substitution.

Quansah's red-card badge explains the cause, where the suspension began, and when it ends; his player profile remains available, while screen readers clearly announce that he is suspended and unavailable.
The suspended-player row is driven by fixture-scoped availability data, so the same presentation can be reused for other documented 2026 suspensions as their metadata is added.
Dark-mode line-up shirt numbers now use the intended black pill with white text and a deep-green pitch outline instead of an isolated white badge; light mode remains unchanged.
Argentina's 2-1 semi-final win over England now includes the official final line-up, goals, cards, substitutions, official highlight, and a concise bilingual three-bullet recap.

The bracket now confirms France vs England for third place and Spain vs Argentina for the final, with a sourced 44/20/36 scenario for the former and a current Betfair/PokerStars 40/31/29 regulation consensus for the latter.

Future result syncs now promote an exact conditional medal-match forecast as soon as both participants are known, preserve extra-time substitution markers, and keep final-state browser checks aligned with confirmed fixtures; the editorial gate now makes missing direct odds or probable-lineup research blocking inside 48 hours of kickoff.
Ball Boy's offside explainer removes the redundant 'The one check' and 'Attacking' heading row, leaving the rule, direction graphic, and legend to explain the idea without decorative duplication.

See sources now groups the app's trust model into FIFA facts, forecast inputs, player information, and official highlights, with an exact-source caveat and matching English, Chinese, Spanish, and Korean footer copy.
highlightsZh: 桌面端比赛详情滚动卡片内的信息提示现在会检测上下裁切；上方空间不足时会在触发按钮下方打开，有足够空间时仍保持原本的向上展示。
贾雷尔·宽萨的停赛替补行不再在胶囊内重复显示“停赛”，状态仍保留在无障碍标签和红牌提示中；较长的说明会自动换行并保持在视口范围内，即使设备支持触控，也能通过键盘聚焦打开。
紧凑布局下从国家搜索结果选择比赛时，现在会平滑滚动到比赛详情；减少动态效果模式仍会立即跳转。
深色模式下展开新上场球员后，换人胶囊会保持完全不透明，避免下方球员头像透出。
Ball Boy 的比赛记分板现在会让双方国旗都保持完整不透明；胜负强调只作用于球队名称文字。
本届赛事已完成的102场阵容现已逐场审核并永久保存准确站位：42场采用 FIFA 官方战术阵容文件，17场采用完全一致的精确来源，34场采用严格来源多数结论，另有9场分歧比赛完成单独复核并保留证据。
球员卡照片现在采用更偏向面部的裁切位置，让异常修长的人像在桌面端和移动端都能清晰显示；图像审查覆盖全部1,248名现役球员的照片尺寸，并对446张人像完成面部检查，同时新增浏览器回归检查来锁定裁切位置。
英格兰半决赛的展开替补席仍只统计14名可出场替补，随后额外显示灰色的停赛球员贾雷尔·宽萨，并且不会让他进入可替换名单。
宽萨的红牌标记会说明停赛原因、停赛从哪场比赛开始以及何时结束；他的球员资料仍可打开，屏幕阅读器也会明确播报他处于停赛且无法出场的状态。
停赛球员行由比赛级别的可用性数据驱动，因此在补充相应资料后，同样的展示方式可以复用于其他有记录的2026年停赛情况。
深色模式下的阵容球衣号码现在使用预期的黑色胶囊、白色文字和深绿色球场描边，不再出现孤立的白色标记；浅色模式保持不变。
阿根廷2比1击败英格兰的半决赛现已补齐官方最终阵容、进球、黄牌、换人、官方集锦，以及简洁的中英双语三点赛果回顾。
淘汰赛对阵现已确认法国对英格兰的季军赛和西班牙对阿根廷的决赛：前者采用有来源支持的44/20/36情景预测，后者采用当前Betfair与PokerStars综合得出的40/31/29常规时间预测。
今后的赛果同步会在双方确定后自动采用完全匹配的奖牌赛条件预测，同时保留加时赛换人标记，并让浏览器检查与已确认的比赛状态保持一致；编辑门槛现在会在开球前48小时内把缺少直接赔率或预计阵容研究视为阻断项。
Ball Boy 的越位说明移除了重复的“只看一个时刻”和“进攻方向”标题行，只保留规则、方向图和图例来解释概念，避免装饰性重复。
“查看来源”现在会按 FIFA 官方事实、预测输入、球员信息和官方集锦整理应用的可信来源，并注明每场比赛的具体来源可能不同；页脚文案已同步支持英语、中文、西班牙语和韩语。

releases.title: Calmer match accessibility and verified line-up placement
releases.titleZh: 更平静的比赛无障碍播报与已核实的阵容站位
highlights: Match rows now give screen readers a concise status, stage, score, penalty outcome, winner, and readable live minute, while each row clearly controls the named Match details panel without changing the visual layout.

Live updates now announce only meaningful changes such as kick-off, goals, phase changes, delays, postponements, cancellations, and full time instead of repeatedly reading the entire match list or detail card.
England and Argentina's semi-final line-ups now use FIFA's official Tactical Line-up document to place every starter in the published tactical row and left/right position.
In dark mode, the line-up pitch now uses one uniform deep-green surface instead of splitting into mismatched upper and lower shades; light mode remains unchanged.

Future matchdays now check FIFA's official Tactical Line-up PDF every five minutes near kickoff and use its positioned text for permanent player rows and left/right placement; the FIFA XI fallback stays conservative while the document is unavailable, with ESPN/FotMob agreement used only as a secondary recovery path.
highlightsZh: 比赛行现在会向屏幕阅读器简洁播报比赛状态、阶段、比分、点球结果、胜者和易读的实时分钟数；每一行也会明确控制名为“比赛详情”的面板，同时不改变视觉布局。
实时更新现在只会播报开球、进球、阶段变化、延迟、延期、取消和终场等有意义的变化，不再反复朗读整份比赛列表或详情卡。
英格兰与阿根廷的半决赛首发阵容现在会采用 FIFA 官方《战术阵容》文件，把每位球员放在公布的战术层级及左右位置。
深色模式下的阵容球场现在采用统一的深绿色表面，不再分成上下两种不一致的色调；浅色模式保持不变。
今后的比赛日会在临近开球时每五分钟检查 FIFA 官方《战术阵容》PDF，并直接读取带坐标的文字来永久确定球员层级及左右站位；文件尚未发布时会保留谨慎的 FIFA 首发回退布局，只有官方文件缺失或无法解析时，才把 ESPN 与 FotMob 的一致结果作为次级恢复路径。

releases.title: Complete dark mode and steadier match details
releases.titleZh: 完整深色模式与更稳定的比赛详情
highlights: Settings now includes a Dark mode switch that follows the device on first visit, then remembers an explicit choice across reloads, tabs, and the Report issue page without a light flash.

Matches, standings, the tournament bracket, predictions, player cards, line-ups, loading states, popovers, native controls, the footer, and the report form now share a deliberately designed high-contrast midnight palette.
Ball Boy keeps its black-and-white identity while every conversation, football explainer, data card, composer state, and mobile layout now adapts cleanly to dark mode in both English and Chinese.

On desktop, the right match-detail card now stays anchored 16px from the top while growing or shrinking into genuinely available space, so the footer and collapsed or expanded World Cup history can no longer push its top off-screen.

The expanded World Cup-history control now points upward toward the records it will hide, and the desktop Report issue form sits 24px higher for more balanced vertical spacing without changing mobile layout or copy.
highlightsZh: 设置中现已加入“深色模式”开关：首次访问会跟随设备偏好，用户明确选择后则会在刷新、多个标签页和“报告问题”页面之间保持一致，并避免加载时闪现浅色界面。
比赛、积分榜、淘汰赛对阵图、预测、球员卡、阵容、加载状态、弹出层、原生控件、页脚和报告表单现在共用一套经过专门设计的高对比度深夜配色。
Ball Boy 保留标志性的黑白形象，同时对话、足球知识讲解、数据卡、输入区状态和移动端布局现在都会在中英文界面中完整适配深色模式。
在桌面端，右侧比赛详情卡现在始终与视口顶部保持16像素距离，并只在真正可用的空间内伸缩；页脚或展开、收起往届世界杯记录都不会再把卡片顶部推到屏幕之外。
展开后的世界杯历史记录控件现在会向上指向将被隐藏的内容；桌面端“报告问题”表单整体上移24像素，使垂直留白更均衡，同时不改变移动端布局或文案。

releases.title: Clearer history controls, roomier match details, and smarter Ball Boy shorthand
releases.titleZh: 更清晰的历史记录控制、更宽敞的比赛详情与更智能的 Ball Boy 简写识别
highlights: Expanded country searches now offer Hide previous World Cups, with a true two-state, count-aware, accessible toggle that collapses the archive cleanly.

On short desktop match pages, scrolling past the header now lets the detail card grow smoothly into real available space while preserving its bottom gap; long archives and mobile layouts keep their existing geometry.
Ball Boy now understands shorthand such as what can u do and no longer mistakes the ordinary word can for Canada's CAN team code.
highlightsZh: 展开国家队搜索中的往届比赛后，现在会显示“隐藏往届世界杯”；这个包含动态场次数量且支持无障碍状态的双向控件，可干净地收起历史记录。
在较短的桌面端比赛页面中，滚过页眉后详情卡会平滑扩展到实际可用空间并保留底部间距；较长的历史列表和移动端布局继续保持原有几何结构。
Ball Boy 现在能理解“what can u do”等简写，也不会再把英语中的普通单词“can”误认为加拿大队代码 CAN。

releases.title: Smarter timezone replies and steadier navigation
releases.titleZh: 更智能的时区回答与更稳定的导航体验
highlights: Ball Boy now remembers when it has asked for a timezone, so replies such as USA open the correct regional choices instead of a country football card; common abbreviations including PDT, AEDT, GMT, and UTC are also recognized.

On desktop, the selected match card now stays alongside long result lists, survives background schedule and data refreshes, expands when the site chrome leaves view, scrolls internally, and resets cleanly when another match is previewed; stacked mobile layouts keep their direct reveal behavior, while keyboard-focused event tooltips and player cards retain priority through incidental pointer movement or scrolling.
The Report issue page now carries the same brand treatment and localized source footer as the main app, including timezone-aware refresh details and the latest release-note highlights.

On mobile, Ball Boy now clears stale Tournament and keyboard viewport offsets as soon as those states end, returning immediately to its normal 12px bottom-right resting position while preserving its other animations.
highlightsZh: Ball Boy 现在会记住自己正在询问时区，因此用户回答“美国”时会显示正确的地区时区选项，而不会误答成国家队资料；PDT、AEDT、GMT 和 UTC 等常见缩写也已支持。
在桌面端，所选比赛卡片现在会与较长的结果列表并排保持可见，并在后台赛程或数据刷新后继续保留；页眉和页脚离开视野后卡片会扩展并支持内部滚动，预览另一场比赛时会干净重置。移动端堆叠布局仍会直接带用户看到详情，键盘聚焦的事件提示和球员卡也不会因偶发指针移动或滚动而失去优先级。
“报告问题”页面现在采用与主应用一致的品牌样式和本地化来源页脚，并显示按用户时区格式化的数据刷新时间及最新发布说明要点。
在移动端，Ball Boy 现在会在离开赛事视图或关闭键盘后立即清除过期的位置偏移，恢复到距右侧和底部各12像素的默认位置，同时保留其他动画效果。

releases.title: Historical player insight, smarter Ball Boy, and cleaner navigation
releases.titleZh: 历史球员解读、更聪明的 Ball Boy 与更顺畅的导航
highlights: All 3,489 historical player profiles from 1930–2022 now use bilingual, evidence-bounded descriptions of play style, movement, technique, and role instead of goal or appearance recaps.

Completed World Cup scoring records remain visible in a separate edition-labeled row, while archive spotlights keep specific evergreen insight and lightly documented players use conservative role-based wording.

Ball Boy can now resolve 419 browser-supported time zones, common city and region aliases, and 11 multi-zone country choices; unknown locations lead to Settings guidance, while unsupported languages remain clearly bounded to English and Chinese.

Next-opponent questions now return the scheduled fixture and time across more English and Chinese phrasings without crashing on matches that have no highlight video or turning empty URLs into broken links.

The Report issue page now includes Ball Boy, a home-aligned top-left Back control and smooth reduced-motion-aware entry, three focused categories plus Others, an unselected localized default, and a larger Send report button that enables only after both required fields are complete.

Match rows now bring off-screen details into view reliably on desktop and mobile, while the wider desktop search pill keeps its icon fixed, preserves mobile geometry, and player-header flags retain full opacity.
highlightsZh: 1930至2022年间全部3,489名历史球员的资料现已采用基于证据的中英文描述，重点解释踢法、跑位、技术和角色，不再用进球或出场回顾充当球员简介。
已完成世界杯的进球记录仍会显示在独立的届次数据行中；重点历史球员保留具体的常青解读，资料较少的球员则使用谨慎的角色型表述。
Ball Boy 现在可识别浏览器支持的419个时区、常见城市与地区别名，并为11个跨时区国家提供选择；无法匹配的位置会引导至设置，而不支持的语言会明确说明目前仅支持中文和英文。
询问下一位对手时，Ball Boy 现在能通过更多中英文表达返回已安排的比赛和时间，不会再因比赛没有集锦视频而崩溃，也不会把空网址变成错误链接。
“报告问题”页面现在加入 Ball Boy、与主页对齐的左上角返回控件和兼顾减少动态效果设置的平滑入场动画，并提供三个聚焦分类与“其他”；问题类型默认不选中，只有两个必填字段都完成后，更大的“发送报告”按钮才会启用。
当比赛详情位于屏幕外时，桌面端和移动端现在都会可靠地将其带入视野；桌面搜索胶囊加宽后图标位置保持不动，移动端几何不变，球员标题中的国旗也保持完全不透明。

releases.title: Evergreen player insight and better Ball Boy controls
releases.titleZh: 常青球员解读与更完善的 Ball Boy 控制
highlights: All 1,248 current player profiles now use unique, bilingual evergreen descriptions focused on play style, decisions, movement, and distinctive strengths; live goals and assists remain in the separate This World Cup row.
Ball Boy player answers present the most useful scouting traits as compact, wrapping skill pills instead of simplistic beginner copy or duplicated tournament totals.
Ball Boy can now offer confirmation-first language and timezone changes through the app's existing Settings controls, while unsupported languages lead to a prefilled Report issue form.
Ball Boy now blinks on a calmer 9–15 second idle cadence, skips the old touch-release blink, and applies a five-second shared cooldown to prevent rapid repeat animations.
On mobile, yellow-card, goal, and assist tooltips now open with a normal tap and close when the user taps elsewhere; desktop hover and keyboard behavior are unchanged.
highlightsZh: 全部1,248名现役球员的资料现已采用独特的中英文常青描述，重点解释踢法、决策、跑位和鲜明优势；实时进球与助攻仍保留在独立的“本届世界杯”数据行中。
Ball Boy 的球员回答现在会用紧凑且可换行的能力标签呈现最有价值的观察要点，不再使用过度简化的新手文案或重复赛事数据。
Ball Boy 现在可以通过应用现有的设置控件，在确认后更改语言和时区；不支持的语言会引导至已预填内容的“报告问题”表单。
Ball Boy 的空闲眨眼间隔现调整为更平静的9至15秒，取消触摸结束时的额外眨眼，并加入5秒共享冷却以避免连续重复动画。
在移动端，黄牌、进球和助攻提示现在可通过普通点按打开，并在点按其他位置时关闭；桌面端悬停和键盘操作保持不变。

releases.title: Richer match stories, team insight, and mobile flow
releases.titleZh: 更丰富的赛后故事、球队解读与移动端体验
highlights: The current-tournament archive now gives all 101 completed matches specific, bilingual result stories: 81 boilerplate recap sets were rewritten, while 20 already-strong sets were preserved.

Recap generation and audits now favor match progression, creators, score swings, substitutions, dismissals, and tournament consequences while rejecting filler such as generic opening- and final-goal lines.

Ball Boy answers how all 48 teams play from shared authored style profiles instead of a generic keyword template, including a specific bilingual explanation of Argentina's press, Messi's positioning, Enzo Fernández's passing, and their defensive priority.

On mobile, opening a match from a long country search keeps the complete result list first, places the detail card below it, and scrolls the selected card into view without changing the desktop layout.
highlightsZh: 本届赛事档案中的101场已完成比赛现在都配有具体的中英文赛后故事：81组模板化总结已重写，20组原本质量较高的内容得到保留。
赛后故事生成与审计现在会优先呈现比赛走势、助攻者、比分变化、替补、红牌和赛事影响，并拦截笼统的首球或末球套话。
Ball Boy 现在通过共享的人工撰写风格档案解释全部48支球队的踢法，不再套用通用关键词模板；其中包括阿根廷的逼抢、梅西的跑位、恩佐·费尔南德斯的传球和无球防守重点。
在移动端从较长的国家队搜索结果中打开比赛时，完整比赛列表会保留在上方，详情卡位于列表下方并自动滚动到可见位置；桌面端布局保持不变。

releases.title: Three-way forecasts and polished Ball Boy behavior
releases.titleZh: 胜平负预测与优化后的 Ball Boy 交互
highlights: Every remaining projected third-place and final pairing now shows regulation-time HOME, TIE, and AWAY percentages instead of a blank card or two-way trophy market.

Direct lookahead markets remain the first choice; unavailable scenarios use a reproducible online-calibrated model blending Opta strength, current markets, official tournament form, stage draw history, and ranking as only one bounded input.
England-Argentina was refreshed to ENG 36%, TIE 32%, ARG 32% from today's Opta and margin-normalized bookmaker prices.
The TIE pill carries the 90-minute draw probability, while its concise tooltip focuses only on the teams' cutoff-safe World Cup shootout evidence.
Ball Boy now uses a contained circular face with subtler pleased and amused reactions, replacing the old flat wink and smile across desktop and compact mobile states.
On mobile, Ball Boy keeps its 12px side insets and rounded shell while the keyboard is open; closed News and Settings buttons stay behind the chat, while their opened panels remain above it.
highlightsZh: 所有剩余的预测季军赛和决赛对阵现在都会显示常规时间主胜、平局和客胜百分比，不再出现空白卡片或只有两项的夺冠市场。
系统仍优先使用直接前瞻市场；当市场尚未开出时，采用可复核的在线校准模型，综合 Opta 实力、当前市场、官方赛事表现、阶段平局历史，并仅把排名作为一个受限输入。
英格兰对阿根廷已按今日 Opta 与去除水位后的庄家价格刷新为：英格兰36%、平局32%、阿根廷32%。
平局胶囊本身显示90分钟战平概率，简洁提示只说明两队在截止时间前可验证的世界杯点球大战依据。
Ball Boy 现在采用完整的圆形脸部，并以更细腻的愉悦和逗趣反应取代原先扁平的眨眼与笑脸，同时适配桌面端和紧凑移动端状态。
在移动端键盘打开时，Ball Boy 仍保留12像素侧边距与圆角外框；关闭状态的新闻和设置按钮会位于聊天框之后，而打开的面板仍会显示在聊天框上方。

releases.title: Refreshed official line-ups and the semifinal prediction
releases.titleZh: 刷新官方阵容与半决赛预测
highlights: FIFA's official sync rechecked all 101 completed team sheets and refreshed seven stored lineup records while preserving each board's verified or provisional placement trust.
The England-Argentina expected lineup was regenerated after its prediction inputs changed, with a new immutable pre-kickoff revision preserved for an honest historical record.
The complete lineup lifecycle and geometry audits now cover 632 team sides and pass under both Node 20 and Node 24.
Repeated official refreshes now retain the frozen pre-kickoff role layout instead of reverting France-Spain to raw team-sheet order.
highlightsZh: FIFA 官方同步重新检查了全部101场已完成比赛的球队名单，并刷新了7条已保存阵容记录，同时保留每块阵容板已验证或暂定站位的可信状态。
英格兰对阿根廷的预计阵容已在预测输入变化后重新生成，并保存新的不可变赛前版本，确保历史记录真实可追溯。
完整阵容生命周期与几何审计现已覆盖632个球队侧面，并同时通过 Node 20 与 Node 24 验证。
重复执行官方刷新时，现在会保留冻结的赛前角色站位，不再把法国对西班牙的阵容退回原始球队名单顺序。

releases.title: Sourced final forecasts and Ball Boy matchup answers
releases.titleZh: 有来源的决赛预测与 Ball Boy 对阵问答
highlights: Ball Boy now understands country-versus-country questions with schedule status, current tournament comparison, and verified senior head-to-head history, including bilingual answers that preserve the teams' typed order.

Matchup follow-ups can answer who would win, the last meeting, and whether one team has beaten another; they use stored pre-match projections or completed results, and decline to invent probabilities for hypothetical fixtures.

Projected finals no longer invent ranking-based percentages: potential Spain-England and Spain-Argentina finals use reproducible conditional consensus from Opta simulations, current bookmaker markets, and prediction-market lookahead prices, with validation blocking unsourced or post-kickoff inputs.
On touch devices, tapping a lineup goal or assist badge now reliably opens its compact event tooltip instead of being intercepted by the generic tooltip handler.
highlightsZh: Ball Boy 现在可以理解国家队对阵提问，回答是否有赛程、本届赛事表现对比和已验证的成年男足交锋历史；中英文回答都会保留用户输入的球队顺序。
对阵后的追问现在可以回答谁更可能获胜、上次交手结果，以及一支球队是否击败过另一支；答案只使用保存的赛前预测或已完成比赛结果，并会拒绝为假设对阵虚构概率。
预测决赛不再使用排名虚构百分比：潜在的西班牙对英格兰和西班牙对阿根廷决赛采用可复核的条件综合预测，数据来自 Opta 模拟、当前庄家市场和预测市场前瞻价格；验证规则会拦截无来源或赛后输入。
在触控设备上，点按阵容中的进球或助攻标记现在会稳定打开精简事件提示，不再被通用提示处理器拦截。

releases.title: Repaired line-up geometry and durable placement checks
releases.titleZh: 修复阵容站位并加入长期几何检查
highlights: Spain-Cabo Verde and Cabo Verde-Saudi Arabia now use repaired verified line-up boards instead of collapsed edge coordinates, including the Saudi starter transliteration match.

A year-independent geometry audit now checks 630 stored official, source, forecast, and archived lineup sides, rejects implausible or collapsed placement data, and prevents malformed verified overrides from reaching the pitch.

Verified-board role labels now follow the measured pitch rows when a provider's compact formation label differs from its displayed shape, keeping left, center, and right roles aligned for past and future imports.
highlightsZh: 西班牙对佛得角和佛得角对沙特阿拉伯现在使用修复后的已验证阵容板，不再把球员挤到球场边缘；沙特首发球员姓名的不同音译也已正确匹配。
新增与年份无关的阵容几何审计，覆盖630个官方、来源、预测和历史阵容侧面；不合理或坍缩的站位会被拒绝，格式错误的已验证覆盖也不会再进入球场界面。
当数据提供方的简写阵型与实际阵容板形状不一致时，已验证阵容的角色标签现在会依据测得的球场行列分配，让过去与未来导入中的左路、中路和右路位置保持一致。

releases.title: Direct bilingual Ball Boy, match SEO, and verified line-ups
releases.titleZh: 直接清晰的双语 Ball Boy、比赛 SEO 与已验证阵容
highlights: Ball Boy now answers players, countries, matches, and rules in a direct bilingual voice, with intent-focused cards, localized Chinese match previews and player notes, clearer rule explanations, and repaired player names; player cards keep the useful beginner explanation without the confusing green role-zone graphic.

Remaining knockout match links now expose match-specific browser and search metadata plus structured event data, while the homepage tab stays branded as World Cup Simplified and the match-row interface, hover, Back, and Forward keep their existing behavior.
Microsoft Clarity now loads once on the main app and report page alongside unchanged Vercel Web Analytics, with the CSP opened only for official Clarity script, collect, and image endpoints.
When yesterday and today have no live or finished match notes during the tournament, Catch Up now shows one sourced Golden Boot race story, then keeps a confirmed post-final tournament wrap.

Line-up boards are shorter with safer mobile substitution taps, and all 101 completed matches now use FIFA-official starting XIs; 92 boards retain exact verified placement while nine provisional cases are honestly labeled, including source disagreements and the role-informed France-Spain completed-match board. Knockout See all links also stay attached to wrapped score text while browser back clears the search state.

All 102 confirmed matchups now use preserved online forecasts: archived market snapshots or pre-match Opta simulations for past matches, plus blended live consensus for both semi-finals. Every confirmed 2026 knockout matchup now has a pre-kickoff shootout outlook, while all 166 eligible archive knockout matches from 1978-2022 add hindsight-safe shootout context; the semi-finals use deeper goalkeeper, taker, and team-history evidence.

Line-up predictions now use independent-source player consensus, ambiguity-safe identities, scalable formation grids, immutable pre-kickoff revisions, and forecast-only accuracy audits. FIFA's France-Spain team sheet automatically replaced the prediction without losing its history; the provisional role layout correctly keeps Koundé at right-back, Dembélé right, Olise central, Barcola left, and Mbappé up front.

Projected final and third-place participants now advance consistently from each semi-final's loaded forecast, including its draw and shootout paths, instead of switching to a separate FIFA-ranking pick.

Tournament and standings integrity now has a repeatable 7,784-check online audit covering all 104 current fixtures and all 965 archived matches; historical tables apply recorded play-offs, head-to-head, drawing-of-lots, and fair-play ordering, while 1950 is shown as a championship pool rather than a knockout path.
highlightsZh: Ball Boy 现在以直接清晰的双语表达回答球员、国家队、比赛和规则问题，并提供针对提问重点的卡片、本地化中文比赛预览与球员说明、更清楚的规则解释，以及修复后的球员姓名；球员卡保留实用的新手说明，同时移除令人困惑的绿色活动区域图。
剩余淘汰赛链接现在会提供比赛专属的浏览器与搜索元数据以及结构化赛事数据；主页标签仍显示 World Cup Simplified，比赛行界面、悬停、返回和前进操作也维持原有行为。
Microsoft Clarity 现在会与保留不变的 Vercel Web Analytics 一起，在主应用和反馈页各加载一次；CSP 只为官方 Clarity 脚本、收集和图片端点放行。
赛事期间，如果昨天和今天没有进行中或已结束的比赛速览，Catch Up 现在会显示一条有来源的金靴奖竞争动态，并在决赛后保留已确认的赛事总结。
阵容板现在更短，移动端换人点按更安全；全部101场已结束比赛现在都使用 FIFA 官方首发，其中92场保留已验证的精确站位，另外9场暂定站位会如实标注，包括来源分歧案例以及依据赛前角色信息排布的法国对西班牙完场阵容板。淘汰赛的“查看全部”链接也会跟随换行后的比分文字，浏览器返回会清空搜索状态。
全部102场已确定对阵现在都采用保留的在线预测：已结束比赛使用存档市场快照或赛前 Opta 模拟，两场半决赛使用实时综合预测。每场已确定的2026年淘汰赛现在都有赛前点球前景，1978至2022年的166场适用历史淘汰赛也加入了不受赛后结果影响的点球背景；两场半决赛还会结合门将、主罚手与球队历史证据。
阵容预测现在使用独立来源的球员级共识、可消除同名歧义的身份匹配、可扩展阵型网格、不可变的赛前版本，以及只统计真正预测的准确率审计。FIFA 公布法国对西班牙首发后已自动替换预测，同时保留赛前历史；临时站位也正确将孔德放在右后卫、登贝莱放在右路、奥利塞放在中路、巴科拉放在左路，并由姆巴佩居中突前。
预测的决赛和季军赛参赛队现在会依据每场半决赛已载入的预测一致晋级，并计入平局与点球路径，不再改用另一套 FIFA 排名选择。
赛事与积分榜现在加入可重复执行的7,784项在线完整性检查，覆盖本届全部104场比赛和历史965场比赛；历史积分榜会按当届规则处理附加赛、相互战绩、抽签与公平竞赛排序，1950年赛事也会正确显示为冠军循环赛，而不是淘汰赛路径。

releases.title: Semifinal predicted line-ups and mobile touch polish
releases.titleZh: 半决赛预测阵容与移动端触控优化
highlights: France-Spain and England-Argentina now have regenerated predicted line-ups while they wait for official team sheets.
On mobile, tapping a substitution pill now swaps the player without accidentally opening the incoming player's card, and the return sub pill stays above the portrait edge.
Line-up boards are slightly shorter at desktop and large-mobile caps while preserving row spacing for long and Chinese labels.
highlightsZh: 法国对西班牙、英格兰对阿根廷现在已重新生成预测阵容，可在官方首发公布前显示。
移动端点按换人标签现在只会切换球员，不会误打开替补球员卡，返回换人标签也会保持在头像边缘上方。
阵容板在桌面端和较大移动端上限略微缩短，同时保留长文本和中文标签所需的行距。

releases.title: Quarterfinal recaps and highlights
releases.titleZh: 四分之一决赛回顾与集锦
highlights: Norway-England now shows the 1-2 extra-time final with three researched recap bullets, Chinese recap copy, official goal events, and a verified FOX Sports YouTube highlight.

Argentina-Switzerland now shows the 3-1 extra-time final with three researched recap bullets, Chinese recap copy, official goal events, a verified FOX Sports YouTube highlight, and the resolved England semi-final path.
The stale Argentina-Switzerland expected lineup was cleared now that the final official lineup is available.
highlightsZh: 挪威对英格兰现在显示1比2加时完场，加入三段有来源的赛果回顾、中文回顾文案、官方进球事件和已验证的 FOX Sports YouTube 集锦。
阿根廷对瑞士现在显示3比1加时完场，加入三段有来源的赛果回顾、中文回顾文案、官方进球事件、已验证的 FOX Sports YouTube 集锦，并更新英格兰半决赛路径。
阿根廷对瑞士的最终官方阵容可用后，已清理过期的预计阵容。

releases.title: Player stats and line-up polish
releases.titleZh: 球员数据与阵容体验优化
highlights: Current player cards now add a compact This World Cup goals-and-assists row when official event data gives the player a non-zero tournament total.
Knockout previous and next context lines now include See all actions for resolved teams, opening the same country search as typing that team name.
Line-up boards now use plain Line-ups for confirmed teams, keep captain markers in the shirt-number pill, center G/A badges, add more row spacing, and label missing live scores as Live score pending.
highlightsZh: 当前球员卡现在会在官方事件数据统计到非零进球或助攻时，加入紧凑的“本届世界杯”进球助攻行。
淘汰赛的上一轮和下一轮说明现在会在已确定球队旁加入“查看全部”，打开与手动搜索该球队相同的国家搜索结果。
阵容板现在会把已确认阵容显示为普通“阵容”，把队长标记放进球衣号码徽章，居中 G/A 徽章，增加行距，并把缺失的实时比分标为“实时比分待确认”。

releases.title: Line-up board touch and badge polish
releases.titleZh: 阵容板触控与徽章优化
highlights: Line-up event badges now float around the player avatar so goals, assists, cards, and substitutions stay readable without pushing names or values out of alignment.
Coach icons now open the in-app coach card instead of navigating away, matching the internal player and formation controls.
On touch devices, tapping the market-value help inside an open player card now keeps the card open and shows the value tooltip.
highlightsZh: 阵容事件徽章现在会浮在球员头像两侧，让进球、助攻、牌和换人信息保持可读，同时不再挤动姓名或身价对齐。
教练图标现在会打开站内教练卡片，不再跳转离开页面，并与球员和阵型的内部控件行为保持一致。
触屏设备上，在已打开的球员卡里点按身价提示时，现在会保持卡片打开并显示身价说明。

releases.title: Prime values and quarterfinal polish
releases.titleZh: 巅峰身价与四分之一决赛优化
highlights: Player cards now show a Prime market-value suffix when the sourced career peak is higher than the current value, backed by generation, validation, and smoke coverage.
Spain-Belgium now shows the 2-1 final with official goal events, FOX Sports highlights, three recap bullets, Chinese recap copy, and no stale probable lineup.
Official FIFA fallback data is refreshed through the July 11 syncs while lineup value spacing remains stable on desktop and mobile.
highlightsZh: 当有来源的生涯峰值高于当前身价时，球员卡现在会显示 Prime 巅峰身价，并配套生成、验证和冒烟覆盖。
西班牙对比利时现在显示2比1完场、官方进球事件、FOX Sports 集锦、三段赛果回顾和中文回顾文案，并移除过期的预测阵容。
官方 FIFA 备用数据已刷新到7月11日同步，同时阵容身价间距在桌面端和移动端保持稳定。

releases.title: Mobile tournament and footer tap polish
releases.titleZh: 移动端赛程图与页脚点按优化
highlights: On mobile, the tournament Show next button now floats from the page bottom-right instead of being clipped by the bracket canvas or browser chrome.
Footer tooltips now keep See release notes open after a normal tap, matching See sources.
highlightsZh: 移动端淘汰赛图里的“Show next”按钮现在会从页面右下角浮动显示，不再被对阵图画布或浏览器底部工具栏截断。
页脚提示现在会在普通点按后保持“查看发布说明”打开，和“查看来源”的行为一致。

releases.title: Footer tooltip taps
highlights: On mobile, See sources and See release notes now open their footer tooltips on tap, switch cleanly, and close when you tap elsewhere.
highlightsZh: 移动端现在可以点按“查看来源”和“查看发布说明”打开页脚提示，两个提示能顺畅切换，并会在点按其他位置时关闭。

releases.title: Predicted line-up coach translations
releases.titleZh: 预测阵容教练翻译修复
highlights: Predicted line-up coach cards now merge missing Chinese note and history copy from the canonical coach profiles, covering France-Morocco and future generated lineups.
highlightsZh: 预测阵容里的教练卡片现在会从权威教练资料补齐缺失的中文战术说明和履历，覆盖法国对摩洛哥以及后续生成的阵容。

releases.title: Player cards and match-control polish
releases.titleZh: 球员卡与比赛操作体验优化
highlights: Player cards now use tournament-grounded notes for current and historical squads, with audit and refresh tooling to keep the copy specific.
Line-up previews now animate into view, keep predicted-source help copy precise, and clear hover cards or tooltips when switching match, calendar, standings, or search views.
The mobile tournament bracket can now jump straight to the next knockout match, and the final card keeps its date label explicit.
highlightsZh: 当前和历史阵容的球员卡现在使用更贴近赛事证据的说明，并加入审核与刷新工具，帮助文案保持具体。
阵容预览现在会以动画进入视图，预测来源提示更精确，并会在切换比赛、日历、积分榜或搜索视图时清理悬浮卡片与提示。
移动端淘汰赛对阵图现在可以直接跳到下一场淘汰赛，决赛卡片的日期标签也会明确标出。

releases.title: Analytics and Chinese-mode performance
releases.titleZh: 分析统计与中文模式性能优化
highlights: The site now loads Vercel Web Analytics from the app root and report page without adding Google Analytics or custom tracking events.
Chinese-mode text replacement now reuses one inline-entity matcher instead of rebuilding many regular expressions during localization.
The match calendar now caches day and month availability, and the next global fixture can still show Up next when it falls on a future selected day.
highlightsZh: 网站现在会在主页面和反馈页面加载 Vercel Web Analytics，不加入 Google Analytics，也不添加自定义追踪事件。
中文模式的内联名称替换现在会复用同一个匹配器，不再在本地化过程中反复重建大量正则表达式。
比赛日历现在会缓存日期和月份可用状态，即使下一个全局比赛在未来选中的日期，也能继续显示“Up next”。

releases.title: Line-up badge and coach copy polish
releases.titleZh: 阵容徽章与教练文案优化
highlights: Line-up event badges now keep touch tooltips tappable, close cleanly, and stay anchored around fixed player marker dimensions on mobile and desktop.
Coach cards now include localized note and history copy with validation and smoke coverage, so Chinese mode does not fall back to English.
highlightsZh: 阵容事件徽章现在在触屏上可点开提示、可干净关闭，并在移动端和桌面端围绕固定球员标记尺寸稳定定位。
教练卡片现在补齐本地化战术说明和履历文案，并加入验证与冒烟覆盖，避免中文模式回退到英文。

releases.title: Admin note emphasis
highlights: The quarterfinals admin note now bolds only the opening phrase while leaving the rest of the sentence at normal weight.
highlightsZh: 四分之一决赛站内便笺现在只加粗开头重点短语，其余句子保持常规字重。

releases.title: Line-up goal badge polish
highlights: Line-up boards now collapse multi-goal player badges into a single count like 2G, keeping the portrait clear while preserving the goal-minute tooltip.
Player event pills now keep substitution and card badges side by side under the name when both apply.
Chinese mode now keeps English, FIFA, group letters, and creator initials literal while localizing player-card clubs and result-story names without stale English leaks.
highlightsZh: 阵容板现在会把多球球员的进球徽章合并成“2G”这样的单个计数，避免遮住头像，同时保留进球分钟提示。
球员事件徽章现在会在换人和黄/红牌同时出现时并排显示在姓名下方。
中文模式现在会保留 English、FIFA、小组字母和作者首字母，同时补齐球员卡俱乐部和赛果故事里的中文姓名，不再漏出奇怪英文。

releases.title: Quarterfinals admin note
releases.titleZh: 四分之一决赛站内便笺
highlights: The top admin note now announces the set quarterfinal field: Argentina, France, Spain, England, Belgium, Morocco, Norway, and Switzerland.
highlightsZh: 顶部站内便笺现在宣布八强席位已定：阿根廷、法国、西班牙、英格兰、比利时、摩洛哥、挪威和瑞士。

releases.title: Switzerland-Colombia shootout recap
releases.titleZh: 瑞士对哥伦比亚点球大战回顾
highlights: Switzerland-Colombia now has a three-beat finished-match recap for the 0-0 draw, Switzerland's 4-3 shootout win, and the final quarterfinal place.
The result card now links the official FOX Sports YouTube highlights for Switzerland-Colombia.
Official lineup cards now preserve captain markers from FIFA team sheets.
highlightsZh: 瑞士对哥伦比亚现在补上了三段式完场回顾，说明0比0僵局、瑞士点球大战4比3取胜以及最后一个八强席位。
赛果卡现在加入瑞士对哥伦比亚的 FOX Sports 官方 YouTube 集锦链接。
官方阵容卡现在会保留FIFA球队名单中的队长标记。

releases.title: Live stoppage-time labels
highlights: Live match detail rows now add FIFA's announced regulation added-time value beside official first-half or second-half minute snapshots when available, such as Current time 97' (+10 added), while extra time and penalties stay separate.
highlightsZh: 直播比赛详情现在会在 FIFA 提供时，把常规时间上半场或下半场官方公布的补时时长显示在官方分钟旁，例如“当前时间 97' (+10 added)”；加时赛和点球大战会保持独立状态。

releases.title: Player photo reliability audit
highlights: Current player profile photos now use verified working image URLs for the broken Egypt, Qatar, Australia, South Africa, Uruguay, Iran, Austria, Colombia, and Canada entries.
A new profile image audit checks every current player photo URL, including Commons metadata redirects, so stale or empty image assets are caught before they fall back to initials.
highlightsZh: 当前球员资料照片现在为此前失效的埃及、卡塔尔、澳大利亚、南非、乌拉圭、伊朗、奥地利、哥伦比亚和加拿大条目改用已验证可用的图片链接。
新增球员资料图片审计，会检查每个当前球员照片链接，包括 Commons 元数据重定向，避免过期或空图片资源上线后才退回首字母占位。

releases.title: Live half-time fallback
highlights: Live score sync now uses FIFA's official live-football period when the calendar MatchTime is blank, so half-time can still show as Half-time instead of a plain checked score.
If FIFA still provides no official position, live score details now say Current time unavailable rather than silently omitting the time row.
highlightsZh: 当赛程接口的 MatchTime 为空时，实时比分同步现在会改用 FIFA 官方 live-football 的 Period 字段，因此半场仍可显示为“半场”，不会只剩普通核验比分。
如果 FIFA 仍未提供官方进程，直播比分详情现在会显示“当前时间不可用”，而不是静默省略时间行。

releases.title: Predicted lineup heading
highlights: Future expected lineup boards now say Line-ups (predicted), while pre-kickoff FIFA team sheets are labeled as official instead of looking like completed-match lineups.
highlightsZh: 未来比赛的预计阵容板现在显示“预测阵容”；开赛前的 FIFA 官方名单则标为官方阵容，不再像完场阵容一样只显示普通标题。

releases.title: Completed lineup refresh fix
highlights: Completed match lineups now flow through the live-data refresh path, so open tabs can pick up official final lineups without a hard refresh.
highlightsZh: 完场比赛阵容现在会通过实时数据刷新路径送达，因此已打开的页面无需强制刷新也能拿到官方最终阵容。

releases.title: Argentina-Egypt result added
releases.titleZh: 阿根廷对埃及赛果更新
highlights: Argentina's 3-2 comeback over Egypt now includes the full scorer timeline, the VAR-reversed Egypt goal context, three recap bullets, and the official FOX Sports YouTube highlights.
highlightsZh: 阿根廷3比2逆转埃及的赛果现已补齐完整进球时间线、埃及进球被VAR取消的关键背景、三条复盘要点以及 FOX Sports 官方 YouTube 集锦。

releases.title: Coach card copy audit
highlights: All lineup coach cards now use the same two-line rhythm: one tactical note plus one career context line, with corrected Colombia and Croatia coach metadata.
Coach cards now show an age line using the same card-note style as player cards when a sourced birth date is available.
highlightsZh: 所有阵容教练卡片现在统一为两行结构：一条战术说明加一条履历背景，并修正了哥伦比亚和克罗地亚教练信息。
当有来源支持的出生日期可用时，教练卡片现在会用与球员卡片相同的说明样式显示年龄。

releases.title: Lineup prediction source quality
releases.titleZh: 阵容预测来源质量提升
highlights: Future match lineup predictions now combine verified recent team sheets with free public probable-lineup sources and availability checks, while confirmed FIFA lineups still replace predictions immediately.
highlightsZh: 未来比赛阵容预测现在会结合近期已验证球队阵容、免费公开预计阵容来源和伤停检查；一旦 FIFA 官方阵容确认，仍会立即替换预测。

releases.title: Live lineup starter rendering
releases.titleZh: 直播阵容首发渲染修复
highlights: Live and final lineup boards now keep all 11 official starters visible after substitutions, while substitute appearances remain represented through lineup event controls.
highlightsZh: 直播和完场阵容板现在会在换人后继续显示全部 11 名官方首发，替补登场则继续通过阵容事件控件呈现。

releases.title: Live match position labels
highlights: Live match rows, tournament cards, and match details now surface the official FIFA position such as 15', Half-time, extra time, or penalties when available.
FIFA live sync now preserves phase values like HT or interval even when they arrive through MatchTime instead of status text.
highlightsZh: 直播比赛行、淘汰赛卡片和比赛详情现在会在可用时显示 FIFA 官方进程，例如 15 分钟、半场、加时或点球大战。
FIFA 实时同步现在会保留通过 MatchTime 而非状态文本传来的 HT 或 interval 等阶段值。

releases.title: Prediction tooltip copy cleanup
highlights: Prediction info buttons now show only the prediction source/method copy, while the work-in-progress caution remains scoped to line-up info buttons.
highlightsZh: 预测信息按钮现在只显示预测来源/方法说明；“仍在开发中”的提示继续仅用于阵容信息按钮。

releases.title: Chinese lineup and recap localization cleanup
releases.titleZh: 中文阵容与复盘本地化清理
highlights: Chinese recap translations now normalize known player surnames inside otherwise translated bullets, preventing names like Trossard or Tielemans from leaking in English.
Lineup coach style chips now share the Chinese glossary used elsewhere, covering labels such as Counter-attack, Defensive organization, and Set-piece focus.
highlightsZh: 中文复盘翻译现在会在已翻译的要点中继续规范已知球员姓氏，避免 Trossard、Tielemans 等名字残留英文。
阵容教练风格标签现在复用全站中文术语表，覆盖“反击”“防守组织”“定位球重点”等标签。

releases.title: Delayed kickoff status handling
highlights: Weather or operations delays can now show a neutral Delayed chip instead of being inferred as Live from the original kickoff time.
Delayed fixtures stay score-free and non-live across match rows, tournament cards, validation, and matchday readiness checks.
highlightsZh: 天气或运营原因导致的开球延迟现在会显示中性的“延迟”标记，而不会仅凭原定开球时间推断为直播。
延迟状态的比赛会在比赛行、淘汰赛卡片、数据验证和比赛日检查中保持无比分、非直播状态。

releases.title: Recent result recaps and official highlights
releases.titleZh: 近期赛果复盘与官方集锦
highlights: Recent finished knockout matches now include concise Result-card story bullets alongside verified FOX Sports YouTube highlight links.
Chinese localization now covers the newest knockout recap bullets so Result cards do not fall back to English prose.
highlightsZh: 近期完场淘汰赛现在在结果卡片中补充简洁复盘要点，并配套已验证的 FOX Sports YouTube 官方集锦链接。
中文本地化现已覆盖最新淘汰赛复盘要点，避免结果卡片回退显示英文段落。

releases.title: Release notes update and official lineup sync hardening
releases.titleZh: 更新日志补齐与官方阵容同步加固
highlights: Added release-note coverage for the latest app translation polish and smoke-test behavior updates.
Official FIFA sync now refreshes final lineups before validation and persists any final lineup updates to `data/lineups.json` as part of fallback snapshot commits.
highlightsZh: 补充最近应用翻译完善与烟雾测试行为更新的更新日志内容，避免产品变更遗漏日志导致校验失败。
官方 FIFA 同步现在会先补齐完场比赛阵容再进行校验，并在官方回填快照提交中持久化 `data/lineups.json` 的任何最终阵容更新。

releases.title: Resolve m88 official-recap translation mapping
releases.titleZh: 修复M88官方复盘映射翻译
highlights: Added missing English/Chinese exact-match tooltip copy for match 88 knockout recap text so unresolved penalty-final result states can render consistently without fallback text.
highlightsZh: 为第88场淘汰赛复盘文本补齐精确英文中文映射，确保未决点球大战结果状态可稳定展示，不再回退到通用文案。

releases.title: Knockout unresolved penalty finals
releases.titleZh: 淘汰赛未决点球大战结果
highlights: Tournament outcome pills remain visible for FT penalty games without an explicit winner, so unresolved tie-breakers do not auto-promote as completed before official winner data arrives.
highlightsZh: 在淘汰赛中，若最终比分为平且官方未给出明确胜者，比赛结果提示不再提前按“已完成”处理，避免未决点球大战提前推进。

releases.title: Result highlight tooltip cleanup
releases.titleZh: 结果集锦按钮文案清理
highlights: Result card official highlights now use the base tooltip text "Play highlights on YouTube" for deterministic UI checks.
highlightsZh: 结果卡片中的官方集锦按钮现在恢复为基础提示语“在 YouTube 播放集锦”，使 UI 校验行为保持一致。

releases.title: Fix startup crash during data load
releases.titleZh: 修复数据加载启动崩溃
highlights: Restored a missing runtime helper used during app startup so initial static data can be applied and the match list renders again instead of showing the data-unavailable error.
highlightsZh: 修复了启动期间缺失的运行时辅助函数，恢复了静态数据应用路径，比赛列表恢复可见，不再在加载后显示数据不可用错误。

releases.title: Lineup coach checks and tied-match smoke fixes
releases.titleZh: 阵容教练检查与平局场景烟雾修复
highlights: Lineup card labeling now handles final and confirmed records consistently while still showing contextual help on final, live, and confirmed lineups.
Tournament smoke checks now better isolate tie outcomes and verify coach coverage and lineup marker positioning with clearer predicates.
highlightsZh: 阵容卡当前状态文案在“最终”和“官方”阵容之间保持一致，并继续在直播、最终和官方阵容下展示说明徽标。
淘汰赛烟雾检查对平局场景拆分得更清晰，并加强了教练覆盖与阵容标记位置的校验。

releases.title: Lineup parser and live-data synchronization
releases.titleZh: 阵容解析与实时数据联动更新
highlights: Live data and lineup parsing now refresh together with stronger guardrails to better keep finalized match lineups and fixture states aligned.
The lineup candidate tooling keeps layout candidate propagation intact while reducing accidental regressions in live-data fallback paths.
highlightsZh: 实时数据与阵容解析更新联动更紧，进一步提高已完场比赛阵容和赛程状态的一致性。
阵容候选工具在保留排布候选传播的同时，加强了实时数据降级路径的防回退。

releases.title: Live score detail wording polish
highlights: Live match details now show the current score under the Live score heading and rewrite the source row to `Current time ...`, checked freshness, and a See latest link.
highlightsZh: 直播比赛详情现在在“实时比分”标题下直接显示当前比分，并将来源行改为“当前时间 ...”、核验时间和“查看最新”链接。

releases.title: Coach age in lineup cards
highlights: Coach lineup hover cards now include age when a valid coach birthDate is present, while still hiding age if birthDate is unavailable.
highlightsZh: 阵容卡的教练悬停卡片现在在有有效出生日期时展示年龄；若缺少出生日期则继续不显示年龄。

releases.title: Coach photos on lineup cards
highlights: Lineup coach photos now render for Tunisia via a curated fallback so both icons and coach cards always show an image when the FIFA payload is missing one.
Production CSP now allows FIFA digitalhub image URLs so coach portraits from official data load the same way as other player visuals.
highlightsZh: 阵容卡中的教练现在在 FIFA 数据缺失时会使用人工补充头像，因此两侧图标与教练卡都始终显示图片。
生产环境 CSP 已放行 FIFA digitalhub 图片地址，保证官方教练头像按玩家头像一样可正常加载。

releases.title: Verified Belgium-Senegal lineup layout
releases.titleZh: 比利时-塞内加尔阵容排布核验
highlights: Belgium-Senegal now keeps FIFA official starters, bench, cards, substitutions, goals, and formation while using a verified pitch layout from matching ESPN and FotMob public match-center checks.
The lineup sync now preserves verified layout overrides across future FIFA refreshes instead of silently falling back to inferred formation-slot positions.
highlightsZh: 比利时对塞内加尔现在继续使用 FIFA 官方首发、替补、红黄牌、换人、进球和阵型，同时采用经 ESPN 与 FotMob 公开比赛中心交叉核验一致的球场排布。
阵容同步现在会在后续 FIFA 刷新中保留已核验的排布覆盖，不会静默退回到按阵型槽位推导的位置。

releases.title: USA-Bosnia highlights
highlights: USA 2-0 Bosnia and Herzegovina now shows the verified FOX Sports YouTube highlight button in the Result card.
highlightsZh: 美国2-0波黑的比赛现在会在 Result 卡片中显示已核验的 FOX Sports YouTube 集锦按钮。

releases.title: Final lineup backfill
highlights: Completed matches now render FIFA official final team sheets on the pitch board, including starters, bench, card-time pills, substitutions, goals, and assists.
Formation hover cards now include contextual good/risk notes for every official shape currently in the final lineup backfill, including 4-1-2-3 and back-five setups.
Goal, assist, yellow-card, and red-card badge tooltips now stay compact with just the minute and event type, while full player details remain available to assistive labels.
Lineup event badge hovers now keep the compact event tooltip above the player card, so goal and assist pills stay readable on desktop.
Lineup event badges can now receive keyboard focus, making the compact event tooltip available without relying on mouse hover timing.

Coach icons stay circular in the formation row without double fallback rings, while the hover card keeps the richer rounded-square portrait, role, tenure, and coach notes where curated metadata exists.
Final lineup backfill now lives in data/lineups.json instead of bloating fixtures.json, with the pitch arrangement still labeled as formation/team-sheet-order derived.
highlightsZh: 已完赛比赛现在会在球场阵容板中显示 FIFA 官方最终队名单，包括首发、替补、带时间的红黄牌胶囊、换人、进球和助攻。
阵型悬停卡现在会为当前最终阵容回填中的每一种官方阵型显示“擅长/可能吃亏”的语境说明，包括 4-1-2-3 和五后卫阵型。
进球、助攻、黄牌和红牌徽标的悬停提示现在只保留分钟和事件类型，完整球员信息仍保留在无障碍标签中。
阵容事件徽标悬停时现在会优先显示紧凑事件提示，不会被球员卡盖住，桌面端的进球和助攻胶囊更清楚。
阵容事件徽标现在可以通过键盘聚焦显示紧凑事件提示，不必依赖鼠标悬停时序。
教练图标在阵型栏保持圆形，且头像回退时不再出现双层圆环；悬停卡片继续使用更丰富的圆角方形头像、身份、执教年份和已策划的教练说明。
最终阵容回填现在存放在 data/lineups.json，不再撑大 fixtures.json；球场排布仍明确标记为按阵型/队名单顺序推导。

releases.title: Official formation and event logs
highlights: All 82 completed matches now carry FIFA official formation, card, and substitution records in match details.
A new FIFA timeline sync imports cards and substitutions automatically after score/scorer updates, with validation rejecting unsourced or malformed event records.
Full lineup boards still stay hidden unless a fixture has complete source-backed starters and bench, so event data cannot be mistaken for an unsourced XI.
highlightsZh: 全部82场已完赛比赛现在会在比赛详情中显示来自FIFA官方的阵型、红黄牌和换人记录。
新的FIFA时间线同步会在比分和进球者更新后自动导入红黄牌与换人，并由校验拒绝无来源或格式错误的事件记录。
完整阵容板仍然只有在赛程拥有带来源的首发与替补名单时才显示，避免事件数据被误认为无来源的首发阵容。

releases.title: Knockout context polish
highlights: English Previous and Next knockout context lines now omit trailing periods when they read as compact match-detail snippets.
Ranking pills in those context sentences now use tighter, matching visual spacing before and after the pill.
highlightsZh: 英文 Previous 和 Next 淘汰赛语境行现在作为紧凑比赛详情提示显示时不再保留句末句点。
这些语境句里的排名胶囊现在在前后两侧使用更紧凑且一致的视觉间距。

releases.title: Lineup accuracy guard
highlights: Lineup pitch coordinates now keep right-sided roles such as RW/RB on the visual right and left-sided roles such as LW/LB on the visual left, with a Spain regression check covering Yamal, Nico Williams, Porro, and Cucurella.
Production match details now hide lineup boards unless a fixture has source-backed lineup data, preventing prototype red-card or substitution badges from looking official.
Data validation now requires future lineup records to include source IDs, checked timestamps, 11 starters per side, and internally consistent cards and substitutions.
highlightsZh: 阵容球场坐标现在会把 RW/RB 等右路角色放在视觉右侧，把 LW/LB 等左路角色放在视觉左侧，并加入覆盖亚马尔、尼科·威廉姆斯、波罗和库库雷利亚的西班牙回归检查。
正式比赛详情现在只有在赛程拥有带来源的阵容数据时才显示阵容板，避免原型红牌或换人标记看起来像官方信息。
数据校验现在要求未来阵容记录包含来源 ID、核验时间、双方各 11 名首发，以及前后一致的红黄牌和换人信息。

releases.title: Coach portraits in lineups
highlights: Covered lineup cards now show Wikimedia-sourced coach portraits for all visible coach source icons, with the smoke test checking for real image URLs.
Coach photos now use the same rounded-square shape as player-card photos instead of circular crops.
Coach cards now follow a consistent description-then-history rhythm, so every covered coach has a tactical note plus a short career line.
Coach history lines were rechecked and tightened for clearer, more current achievements.
highlightsZh: 已覆盖的阵容卡片现在会为所有可见教练来源图标显示来自维基共享资源的教练头像，并由冒烟测试检查真实图片链接。
教练照片现在使用与球员卡照片一致的圆角方形，不再裁成圆形。
教练卡片现在统一为“战术描述 + 履历补充”的节奏；每位已覆盖教练都有一条战术说明和一条简短履历。
教练履历行已经重新核对并打磨，改为更清楚、更新的代表成就。

releases.title: Lineup coach coverage
highlights: Covered line-up cards now source coach metadata from the shared lineup model, so generated matches show both coach icons instead of only the hand-authored England-DR Congo card.
The UI smoke test now clicks every covered lineup match and fails if either coach source icon is missing.
highlightsZh: 已覆盖的阵容卡片现在从共享阵容模型读取教练资料，因此生成的比赛也会显示双方教练图标，不再只有手写的英格兰对刚果民主共和国卡片完整。
UI 冒烟测试现在会点击每一场已覆盖阵容的比赛；如果任一方教练来源图标缺失，就会失败。

releases.title: Live fallback safety
releases.titleZh: 直播备用数据安全处理
highlights: If live-data sync times out, the API now avoids CDN-caching the failed fallback, tries a fast FIFA official score rescue, and strips stale live scores from raw static fallback data.
highlightsZh: 如果实时数据同步超时，API 现在不会把失败的备用响应缓存到 CDN，会先尝试快速使用 FIFA 官方比分兜底，并从原始静态备用数据中移除过期的直播比分。

releases.title: Round-of-32 result recaps
highlights: USA-Bosnia and Belgium-Senegal now show official final scores, scorer timelines, source-backed three-bullet Result recaps, and the USA-Belgium last-16 matchup.
Belgium-Senegal includes the verified FOX Sports YouTube highlights link; USA-Bosnia records an official FOX Sports check while the full highlights upload is still unavailable.
highlightsZh: 美国对波黑、比利时对塞内加尔现在显示官方最终比分、进球时间线、基于来源的三条赛果复盘，以及美国对比利时的16强对阵。
比利时对塞内加尔已加入已核验的 FOX Sports YouTube 集锦链接；美国对波黑则记录了官方 FOX Sports 检查，完整集锦尚未可用。

releases.title: Lineup status wording
highlights: Lineup cards now describe their state more naturally: predicted lineups stay freshness-based, live matches show a lineup record check, and finished matches settle into Line-ups with Final lineup record.
highlightsZh: 阵容卡片现在会按状态显示更自然的文案：预测阵容保留新鲜度提示，直播比赛显示阵容记录核验，完场后显示“阵容”和“最终阵容记录”。

releases.title: Hover cards stay unpinned
highlights: Desktop clicks on non-link hover-card triggers no longer pin a card; real source links still work, keyboard access stays intact, and touch taps still open one card at a time.
highlightsZh: 桌面端点击非链接类悬停卡片触发器不再固定卡片；真实来源链接仍可打开，键盘访问保持不变，触屏轻点仍一次只打开一张卡片。

releases.title: Lineup tab fit
highlights: Lineup cards now keep compact team-code tabs such as USA and BIH content-sized and height-matched with the formation chip, without losing full accessible country names.
highlightsZh: 阵容卡片现在会让 USA、BIH 这类紧凑球队代码标签按内容收紧，并与阵型标签保持同高，同时保留完整的无障碍国家名称。

releases.title: Live row spacing polish
highlights: Wrapped live match rows now keep the vs label tight to the first country and pull the Live/score pills next to the matchup instead of leaving a wide desktop gap.
highlightsZh: 换行的直播比赛行现在会让 vs 更贴近第一支球队，并把 Live/比分标签拉回对阵信息旁边，不再在桌面端留下过宽空白。

releases.title: Live score source line
highlights: Live match details now replace the manual full-time reminder with the checked FIFA snapshot minute, freshness, and a dotted Check FIFA source link.
In-play match details now place the Live score section above the Previous/Next knockout context, matching the finished Result layout.
highlightsZh: 直播比赛详情现在用已核验的 FIFA 快照分钟、新鲜度和带点状下划线的“查看 FIFA”来源链接，替代原来的完场刷新提醒。
进行中的比赛详情现在会把实时比分区块放在 Previous/Next 淘汰赛背景上方，和完场 Result 布局保持一致。

releases.title: Live match predictions
highlights: Live match details now keep the Prediction card below the live score, so Belgium-Senegal and other in-play fixtures do not lose their pre-match odds context.
highlightsZh: 直播比赛详情现在会把 Prediction 卡片保留在实时比分下方，像比利时对塞内加尔这样的进行中比赛不会丢失赛前预测背景。

releases.title: Lazy archive player cards
releases.titleZh: 历届球员卡片延迟加载
highlights: Historical player-card data now loads only when archive match details need it, with a small card-level loading state keeping current 2026 match browsing lighter while preserving rich past-player cards.
highlightsZh: 历届球员卡片数据现在只会在历届比赛详情需要时加载，并用小型卡片级加载状态过渡，让 2026 当前比赛浏览更轻，同时保留丰富的历史球员卡片。

releases.title: Line-ups on match cards
highlights: Covered line-ups now render directly on the match detail card instead of requiring a preview URL flag.
Tomorrow's scheduled Round of 32 matches now have expected-lineup mock coverage, and live pages can still show the expected-labelled lineup visual.
highlightsZh: 已覆盖的阵容现在会直接显示在比赛详情卡片中，不再需要预览链接参数。
明天的32强赛程现在补上预计阵容的模拟覆盖；直播页也可以继续显示带“预计阵容”标签的阵容视觉。

releases.title: Result-first match details
highlights: Finished matches now place Result above Previous and Next context, while upcoming matches still start with Previous context.
highlightsZh: 已完赛比赛现在会把“赛果”放在 Previous 和 Next 语境上方，未开赛比赛仍从 Previous 语境开始。

releases.title: Previous context divider refresh
highlights: Knockout Previous sections now load the refreshed divider styling through the latest app cache version.
highlightsZh: 淘汰赛 Previous 区块现在会通过最新应用缓存版本加载更新后的分隔线样式。

releases.title: Line-ups visual prototype and official result sync
releases.titleZh: 阵容可视化原型与官方赛果同步
highlights: Added a guarded England-DR Congo line-ups visual prototype below Prediction, with team tabs, bench lists, coach and formation cards, player photos, card markers, and substitution previews.
Expanded the guarded line-ups visual prototype across yesterday and today, including a clear Line-ups (prediction) label for scheduled matches and past-match line-ups for finished knockouts.
Match detail sections now use subtle dividers and roomier Key information spacing so the new visual fits the existing page rhythm.
Synced Belgium-Senegal to the official 3-2 final, linked the official FOX highlight, and resolved Belgium's next knockout slot.
highlightsZh: 在 Prediction 下方新增受保护的英格兰对刚果民主共和国阵容可视化原型，包含球队切换、替补名单、教练与阵型卡、球员照片、红黄牌标记和换人预览。
受保护的阵容可视化原型已扩展到昨天和今天的比赛，未开赛比赛会明确显示“预测阵容”，已完赛淘汰赛则显示赛后阵容。
比赛详情区块现在使用更克制的分隔线，并增加 Key information 的呼吸感，让新视觉更贴合现有页面节奏。
已同步比利时对塞内加尔的官方 3-2 完赛比分，补上 FOX 官方集锦，并确认比利时的下一轮淘汰赛席位。

releases.title: England-DR Congo Result story and official highlight
releases.titleZh: 英格兰对刚果民主共和国赛果故事与官方集锦
highlights: England-DR Congo now has source-backed Result story bullets for Cipenga's early opener, England's pressure shift, and Kane's late comeback goals.
The Result card now links the verified official FOX Sports highlight upload.
highlightsZh: 英格兰对刚果民主共和国现在补上有来源支撑的赛果故事，涵盖奇彭加早早破门、英格兰压力转换和凯恩最后阶段逆转进球。
赛果卡片现在链接已核验的 FOX Sports 官方集锦上传。

releases.title: Live pill click tooltips
highlights: Live pills now open the official FIFA snapshot tooltip on click or tap across match rows and tournament cards, without sending people to the FIFA scores page.
highlightsZh: 直播标签现在会在比赛列表和 Tournament 卡片中通过点击或轻点打开官方 FIFA 快照提示，不再跳转到 FIFA 比分页。

releases.title: Mexico recap clarity
highlights: Mexico-Ecuador's Result recap now says the home crowd was lifted in Mexico City instead of relying on Azteca shorthand.
highlightsZh: 墨西哥对厄瓜多尔的赛果复盘现在直接写明墨西哥城主场球迷被带动，不再依赖 Azteca 这个简称。

releases.title: Archive Tournament cleanup
highlights: The 1974, 1978, and 1982 archived Tournament tabs now show only bracket and placement matches, keeping second-stage group pools out of the swipeable Tournament canvas.
Archived Groups still use those second-stage results to highlight who advanced through the older formats.
highlightsZh: 1974、1978 和 1982 年的历届 Tournament 视图现在只显示淘汰赛和名次赛，不再把第二阶段小组赛放进可滑动 Tournament 画布。
历届 Groups 仍会使用这些第二阶段赛果来标出旧赛制中真正晋级的球队。

releases.title: Archive first-round context
highlights: Historical first-round knockout matches from no-group World Cups, such as 1934 Preliminary round games, now omit the empty Previous group-round block while keeping the next-round path.
highlightsZh: 没有小组赛的历届世界杯首轮淘汰赛（如 1934 年预赛轮）现在不再显示空的 Previous 小组赛区块，同时保留下一轮路径。

releases.title: Historical key info headings
highlights: Past World Cup match details now give each country's Key information title a historical team-style description, so teams such as 1982 Italy no longer fall back to only the country name.
highlightsZh: 历届世界杯比赛详情现在会为每个国家的关键信息标题显示历史球队风格描述，像 1982 年意大利不会再只显示国家名。

releases.title: Mexico-Ecuador Result update
releases.titleZh: 墨西哥对厄瓜多尔赛果更新
highlights: Mexico-Ecuador now shows the verified final score, FIFA goal timeline, official FOX Sports highlights button, and source-backed Result story bullets.
Germany-Paraguay and Netherlands-Morocco Result stories now include source research records for their knockout shootout recaps.
highlightsZh: 墨西哥对厄瓜多尔现在显示已核验终场比分、FIFA 进球时间线、FOX Sports 官方集锦按钮和有来源支撑的赛果故事。
德国对巴拉圭、荷兰对摩洛哥的赛果故事现在也为淘汰赛点球复盘补上来源研究记录。

releases.title: Match title descender fix
releases.titleZh: 比赛标题字母下缘修正
highlights: Large matchup titles now give team-name descenders more room, so letters like the g in Senegal are not clipped.
highlightsZh: 大型对阵标题现在给球队名称中字母下缘留出更多空间，像 Senegal 里的 g 不会再被裁切。

releases.title: Faster juggle opening drop
highlights: The hidden soccer-ball juggle now starts with a quicker opening drop, closer to the pace of the ball after the first tap.
highlightsZh: 隐藏的足球颠球小游戏现在开局下落更快，更接近第一次点击后足球的节奏。

releases.title: Up-next score cleanup
highlights: Upcoming match rows now ignore provider pre-match 0-0 score shells, so an Up next fixture stays unscored until a live or final status is verified.
Validation, audit, and smoke checks now fail if scheduled/upcoming fixtures carry score artifacts or render conflicting score/status pills.
highlightsZh: 即将开始的比赛行现在会忽略数据源赛前返回的 0-0 占位比分，只有在核验为直播或完赛状态后才显示比分。
校验、审计和冒烟测试现在会拦截带有比分字段或渲染出冲突比分/状态标签的待赛比赛。

releases.title: Archive group advancement
highlights: Archived Groups tables now use the same green row treatment as 2026 for teams that actually reached the Tournament stage, including older one-winner groups, group-playoff winners, and final-round group qualifiers.
highlightsZh: 历届 Groups 表现在会像 2026 年一样，用绿色行标出真正进入 Tournament 阶段的球队，包括早期单一小组头名、小组附加赛胜者和决赛轮小组晋级球队。

releases.title: Prediction heading alignment
highlights: Mobile info cards now keep the Prediction source info button vertically centered with the heading while preserving the Result play button alignment.
highlightsZh: 移动端信息卡现在会让 Prediction 来源信息按钮与标题垂直居中，同时保留 Result 播放按钮的对齐效果。

releases.title: Archive tournament brackets
highlights: The 1954 and 1958 archived Tournament tabs now start at the real knockout bracket, keeping group tie-breaker play-offs out of the bracket columns and quarter-final Previous context.
highlightsZh: 1954 和 1958 年的历届 Tournament 视图现在从真正的淘汰赛阶段开始，不再把小组附加赛放进对阵列或四分之一决赛的 Previous 语境。

releases.title: Live pill hover
highlights: Live match rows and tournament cards no longer shift while the Live pill time tooltip is targeted on desktop.
highlightsZh: 桌面端指向 Live 标签的比赛时间提示时，直播比赛行和 Tournament 卡片不再位移。

releases.title: Archive kickoff times
highlights: Past World Cup match rows now show researched local kickoff times when Wikidata match-item time-of-day data is available, including the 1930 Uruguay-Yugoslavia semi-final.
Cancelled date-only archive fixtures stay blank instead of showing an invented fallback time.
highlightsZh: 历届世界杯比赛行现在会在 Wikidata 比赛条目提供开球时间时显示已研究核验的当地开球时间，包括 1930 年乌拉圭对南斯拉夫的半决赛。
已取消且只有日期的存档赛程会保持空白，不显示推算出来的占位时间。

releases.title: Result-story research queue
highlights: The FIFA sync workflow now reports finished matches that still need source-backed Result story research after scorer and official-video sync.
The Result card keeps the verified score, scorer timeline, and official video without publishing generic story filler while researched bullets are pending.
Researched current-match recaps now favor short, natural sentences and reject colon/dash-shaped summary prose.
highlightsZh: FIFA 同步流程现在会在射手和官方视频同步后，报告仍需要来源支撑的 Result 故事研究的完赛比赛。
研究型故事待补充时，Result 卡片会保留已核验比分、进球时间线和官方视频，但不会发布泛泛的故事填充文案。
经过研究的当前比赛复盘现在会采用更短、更自然的句子，并拒绝冒号或破折号式的摘要腔。

releases.title: Juggle game difficulty
highlights: The hidden soccer-ball juggle now keeps ramping after longer streaks, with subtly stronger kicks, quicker drops, and messier side-wall bounce recovery.
highlightsZh: 隐藏的足球颠球小游戏现在会在更长连击后继续轻微提高难度，踢球更有力、下落更快，撞到侧边后的恢复也更乱。

releases.title: France result recap
highlights: France-Sweden now shows the 3-0 full-time score, the scorer timeline, and a tighter Result recap centered on Mbappe's super-goal opener and Olise's two assists.
The Result card now links the official FOX Sports YouTube highlights once the verified upload is available.
Current-match story bullets now stay out of the automatic post-FT path until source-backed research writes them; scorer and assist facts can still update from the official FIFA timeline.
highlightsZh: 法国对瑞典现在显示 3-0 全场比分、进球时间线，并用更紧凑的赛果复盘突出姆巴佩的神仙首球和奥利塞的两次助攻。
经过核验的 FOX Sports 官方 YouTube 集锦上线后，赛果卡片现在会显示播放按钮。
当前比赛的赛果故事要等有来源支撑的赛后研究写入后才会发布；射手和助攻事实仍可从 FIFA 官方时间线自动更新。

releases.title: Official archive videos
highlights: More 2018 and 2022 archive matches now show official FIFA YouTube highlights, while non-FIFA uploads remain hidden.
highlightsZh: 更多 2018 和 2022 年历届比赛现在会显示 FIFA 官方 YouTube 集锦；非 FIFA 上传的视频仍会隐藏。

releases.title: Tie wording consistency
highlights: Prediction bars, head-to-head records, standings help, and knockout result summaries now use Tie instead of Draw across English views.
highlightsZh: 英文界面的预测条、交锋记录、积分榜说明和淘汰赛赛果摘要现在统一使用 Tie，不再使用 Draw。

releases.title: Historical player photos
highlights: More past World Cup player cards now use verified Wikipedia/Wikimedia photos, including targeted Final and Semi-finals scorer, key-player, and team-description mentions while ambiguous image matches stay as initials.

A new exact-title batch lookup plus a Wikidata P18 Commons fallback expands historical player photo coverage past 2,500 cards while rejecting known team-lineup, same-name, and non-profile image matches.
Historical photo coverage metadata now records the Finals/Semi-finals target set separately from the all-profile photo count.
highlightsZh: 更多历届世界杯球员卡片现在会使用已核验的 Wikipedia/Wikimedia 照片，包括针对决赛和半决赛射手、关键球员以及球队描述提及球员的补图；有歧义的图片匹配会继续保留首字母头像。
新的精确标题批量查找加上 Wikidata P18 Commons 兜底，把历届球员照片覆盖率提升到 2,500 张以上，同时会拒绝已知的全队合影、同名误配和非个人头像匹配。
历届照片覆盖率元数据现在会把决赛/半决赛目标名单与全部球员卡照片总数分开记录。

releases.title: Archive first-meeting copy
highlights: Past World Cup archive sections now label their scope and first meetings say the teams had not met in a men's World Cup before that match, while current fixtures keep verified senior-international H2H wording.
highlightsZh: 历届世界杯交锋区块现在会标明范围，首次交锋也会说明双方此前没有男足世界杯交锋；当前赛程仍保留已核验成年队交锋文案。

releases.title: Archive knockout path emphasis
highlights: Past World Cup Next-path lines now semibold the resolved opponent winner, matching the current tournament treatment.
highlightsZh: 历届世界杯的下一轮路径文案现在会加粗已确认晋级的对手，和当前赛事保持一致。

releases.title: Tooltip card layering
highlights: Tournament, standings, match-detail, and match-list tooltips now lift their host card or row above neighboring cards while visible.
highlightsZh: 淘汰赛、积分榜、比赛详情和比赛列表中的提示框现在显示时会把所属卡片或行提升到相邻卡片之上。

releases.title: Standings year heading
highlights: The Standings page heading now shows only the selected year with a dropdown chevron, matching the compact Today date picker style on Matches.
highlightsZh: 积分榜页面标题现在只显示所选年份并带下拉箭头，与 Matches 中紧凑的“今天”日期选择样式保持一致。

releases.title: Tournament Live time tooltip
highlights: Desktop hover on the tournament-card Live badge now shows the same official FIFA snapshot minute when MatchTime is available.
highlightsZh: 桌面端悬停淘汰赛卡片上的 Live 标记时，现在会在 FIFA MatchTime 可用时显示同样的官方快照分钟。

releases.title: Brazil-Norway projection repair
highlights: Brazil vs Norway now has its ranking-based prediction loaded, and the data pipeline now refreshes projections whenever confirmed fixtures update.
highlightsZh: 巴西对挪威现在已加载基于排名的预测；数据流水线也会在已确认赛程更新时刷新预测。

releases.title: Knockout path ranking pills
highlights: Next-round path copy now shows FIFA ranking pills for both the winning opponent and the defeated team named in that result.
highlightsZh: 下一轮路径文案现在会为已晋级对手和该赛果中被击败的球队都显示 FIFA 排名标签。

releases.title: Norway advance update
highlights: Norway's 2-1 win over Côte d'Ivoire now updates the score, goal timeline, official highlight link, Brazil-Norway H2H context, and a sourced Result recap around Nusa, Diallo, Haaland, and Nyland.
highlightsZh: 挪威 2-1 战胜科特迪瓦后，现在已更新比分、进球时间线、官方集锦链接、巴西对挪威的交锋背景，并补充围绕努萨、迪亚洛、哈兰德和尼兰的来源支撑赛果复盘。

releases.title: Result recap reliability
highlights: Fresh full-time recaps now keep opener, equalizer, and late-winner bullets in match order before the enriched JSON lands.
Result enrichment checks now fail scoring-match recaps with too few story bullets or out-of-order goal-minute bullets.
highlightsZh: 刚结束比赛的复盘现在会在富化 JSON 到达前，也按开场进球、扳平、绝杀的顺序展示要点。
赛果富化检查现在会拦截要点过少或进球分钟顺序错乱的有进球复盘。

releases.title: Standings reliability
highlights: Standings badge checks now use stable team identity behind the scenes, keeping the release pipeline reliable across language changes.
highlightsZh: 积分榜标记检查现在会在后台使用稳定的球队身份，让发布流水线在语言切换后也保持可靠。

releases.title: Language switch feedback
highlights: English/Chinese switching now shows a subtle spinner on the selected language tab while the page rerenders.
highlightsZh: 英文/中文切换现在会在所选语言标签上显示轻量加载提示，直到页面完成重绘。

releases.title: Chinese route player links
highlights: Chinese result bullets now keep short route labels like Hakimi-Brahim while linking each player to the hover card.
highlightsZh: 中文赛果要点现在会保留哈基米-布拉欣这类短路线名称，同时把每名球员链接到悬浮卡。

releases.title: Archived bracket alignment
highlights: Past tournament brackets now place the Final and 3rd place match on the same centered end path as the 2026 tournament view.
highlightsZh: 历届赛事淘汰赛现在会像 2026 赛事视图一样，将决赛和季军赛放在居中的同一条终点路径上。

releases.title: Mobile top spacing alignment
highlights: Matches and Standings now start from the same mobile content offset below the top navigation.
highlightsZh: 移动端 Matches 和 Standings 现在会在顶部导航下方使用一致的内容起始间距。

releases.title: Mobile Live time tooltip
highlights: Tapping a Live pill on mobile now opens the FIFA snapshot time tooltip first instead of immediately leaving the app.
highlightsZh: 移动端点击 Live 标记现在会先打开 FIFA 快照时间提示，不会立即离开应用。

releases.title: Mobile tournament status badges
releases.titleZh: 移动端淘汰赛状态标记
highlights: Tournament Live and Up next badges now use the same compact sizing on small mobile screens.
highlightsZh: 淘汰赛 Live 和 Up next 标记现在会在小屏移动端使用一致的紧凑尺寸。

releases.title: Automatic H2H sync
highlights: Resolved knockout matchups now sync verified senior head-to-head records from National Football Teams, clearing the Mexico-Ecuador pending card and the current resolved H2H backlog.
Synced H2H records now exclude the fixture itself, keeping past-meeting summaries strictly before the selected match.
highlightsZh: 已确定的淘汰赛对阵现在会从 National Football Teams 同步已核实的成年队交锋记录，清除了墨西哥对厄瓜多尔的待补充卡片以及当前已确定对阵的交锋积压。
同步的交锋记录现在会排除比赛本身，确保历史交锋摘要只统计所选比赛之前的交手。

releases.title: Next path winner emphasis
highlights: Resolved Next path lines now semibold the known opponent winner, so entries like Paraguay advancing on penalties match the Previous context emphasis.
highlightsZh: 已确定的“下一轮”路径现在会半粗显示对手胜者，让点球晋级的巴拉圭等文案与“上一轮”背景强调保持一致。

releases.title: Chinese detail localization
highlights: Chinese Catch Up, Result details, H2H competition labels, shootout score notes, and tactical-route lines now localize before display, while mobile standings help tooltips stay inside the match card.
highlightsZh: 中文“速览”、“赛果”详情、交锋赛事标签、点球比分注记和战术路径句现在会先本地化再展示，同时移动端积分榜帮助提示会保持在比赛卡片内。

releases.title: H2H empty-state copy
highlights: Pending H2H cards now show a concise not-loaded message instead of internal research instructions, with Chinese fallback coverage for empty states.
highlightsZh: 待补充的交锋卡片现在显示简洁的尚未载入提示，不再展示内部研究说明，并补齐空状态的中文兜底。

releases.title: Past 24 hours layout
highlights: Past 24 hours match cards now stay in one full-width column on desktop and mobile.
highlightsZh: “过去24小时”的比赛卡片现在在桌面端和移动端都保持单列全宽显示。

releases.title: Smarter country search
highlights: Country search now recognizes lightweight pinyin, traditional Chinese, and common alternate names while keeping exact aliases and short English prefixes precise.
highlightsZh: 国家队搜索现在支持轻量拼音、繁体中文和常见别名，同时让精确别名和短英文前缀保持准确。

releases.title: Archive card context
highlights: Archived knockout match details now use the same Previous and Next context style as current World Cup cards, with Result shown below that path context.
Archived Previous knockout context now semibolds the teams that advanced, matching current World Cup path summaries.
Replay-era and 1950 final-round archive cards now show replay or standings context instead of forcing a modern bracket path.
Historical archive tables now use era-appropriate win points.
Hidden player-card tooltips no longer widen archived match details before a player name is hovered.
highlightsZh: 历届淘汰赛比赛详情现在使用与当前世界杯卡片一致的“上一轮”和“下一轮”背景样式，并将“赛果”显示在路径背景下方。
历届“上一轮”淘汰赛背景现在会半粗显示晋级球队，与当前世界杯路径摘要保持一致。
重赛年代和1950年决赛轮的存档卡片现在显示重赛或积分榜背景，而不是强行套用现代淘汰赛路径。
历届存档积分榜现在使用对应年代的胜场积分规则。
隐藏的球员卡片提示现在不会在悬停前撑宽历届比赛详情。

releases.title: Mobile heading spacing
highlights: On mobile, the Today heading now uses the same top-navigation spacing as the standings year heading while desktop spacing stays unchanged.
highlightsZh: 移动端的“今天”标题现在与积分榜年份标题使用一致的顶部导航间距，同时桌面端间距保持不变。

releases.title: Archived tournament tabs
highlights: Archived standings years now include a Tournament tab, so years like 2010 and 2022 open on their completed knockout bracket while Groups remains available.
highlightsZh: 历届年份的积分榜现在也包含“淘汰赛”页签，因此2010、2022等年份会先打开已完赛淘汰赛对阵，同时仍可切回小组积分榜。

releases.title: Cleaner shootout recaps
releases.titleZh: 更自然的点球大战速览
highlights: Current and historical penalty-shootout Result bullets now keep the scorer timeline, add matchup-specific texture when available, and avoid generic eliminated-after-penalties filler.
Past World Cup archive recaps were refreshed so scoreless ties and shootouts no longer pad Result blocks with repeated locked-together or plain shootout-outcome lines.
Finished-match recap audits now catch weak story filler in both the 2026 tournament and historical archive.
highlightsZh: 当前赛事和历届存档的点球大战“赛果”速览现在会保留进球时间线，在可用时加入对阵特点，并避免泛泛的点球出局填充句。
历届世界杯存档速览已刷新，因此0-0平局和点球大战不再用重复的胶着到终场或普通点球结果句填充“赛果”区。
完赛比赛速览审计现在会同时检查2026赛事和历届存档中的弱故事句。

releases.title: Mobile tournament polish
highlights: On mobile tournament cards, the Up next badge now uses smaller text so it stays compact without changing the approved desktop card styling.
highlightsZh: 移动端淘汰赛卡片的“即将开始”标签现在使用更小文字，让标签更紧凑，同时保留桌面端已确认的卡片样式。

releases.title: Smarter result recaps
highlights: Finished match Result blocks now show a semibold score line, scorer timeline, and three plain-text recap bullets without emoji markers.
Completed current matches now include a Result play button when FOX Sports has an official YouTube highlights video.
Germany-Paraguay and Netherlands-Morocco now link their official FOX Sports Round of 32 highlight videos.
Official FOX Sports highlight lookup now runs in the matchday and scheduled sync paths, so newly finished matches keep checking for a safe YouTube link automatically.
Completed matches without an official YouTube upload now carry an explicit checked status so missing play buttons are deliberate, not silent data gaps.
Historical archive matches now show the same Result play button after an all-match official FIFA YouTube sweep, with unchecked or non-highlight videos kept out of the UI.
App asset cache keys now point at the official highlight sync build so refreshed highlight-video data reaches the browser immediately.
Chinese result bullets now translate penalty-shootout and archive recap sentence shapes through shared rules, with copy audits covering both current and historical tournaments.
Tied knockout results now say when a team advanced after a tie if the official feed has not exposed a shootout total yet.
Next-round knockout cards now name an already-known future opponent with the result they advanced by, while unresolved paths still say winner of the pending matchup.
Live FIFA score updates now carry penalty-shootout totals too, knockout rows show the compact 1-1 (3-4 pens) style with freshness, and bracket result pills now match that scoreline style.
The live-data endpoint now fails safely to the committed fallback snapshot instead of serving a Vercel timeout page when FIFA's official API is slow.
Knockout match rows no longer show the redundant Predicted chip when unresolved Winner match paths already make the projection clear.
Brazil vs Japan now has richer story bullets for Japan's defensive pressure, the early Sano opener, and Brazil's late Martinelli winner.

Historical World Cup result pages now use generated story bullets too, so archive matches such as Russia vs Egypt 2018 mention the own goal, Dzyuba finish, and Salah penalty instead of generic points lines.

Archived World Cup Result blocks now match current-match recap structure with a semibold score line, scorer row, bullet story facts, and player-card mentions that do not jump to the raw GitHub dataset.
Archived knockout match context now uses the round name directly instead of the extra Knockout context archive heading.
highlightsZh: 完赛比赛的“赛果”区现在显示半粗比分句、进球时间线，以及三条不带表情符号的文字速览。
当前赛事已完赛比赛在 FOX Sports 有官方 YouTube 集锦时，现在会在“赛果”旁显示播放按钮。
德国对巴拉圭、荷兰对摩洛哥现在已接入 FOX Sports 官方32强赛集锦视频。
FOX Sports 官方集锦查询现在已接入比赛日和定时同步流程，新完赛比赛会自动持续查找安全的 YouTube 链接。
已完赛但暂无官方 YouTube 集锦的比赛现在会记录明确的检查状态，因此没有播放按钮是有意状态，而不是静默数据缺口。
历届世界杯存档比赛现在经过全量官方 FIFA YouTube 检查；只有匹配到官方集锦类视频时才会在“赛果”旁显示同样的播放按钮。
应用资源缓存键现在指向官方集锦同步版本，让刷新后的集锦视频数据能立即进入浏览器。
中文赛果速览现在会通过共享规则翻译点球大战和存档赛事句式，文案审计也会同时覆盖当前赛事与历届世界杯。
淘汰赛打平但官方数据尚未给出点球总比分时，现在会说明哪支球队在平局后晋级。
淘汰赛下一轮卡片现在会在未来对手已确定时写出该队和晋级比分，路径未决时仍保留“对阵某场胜者”的说法。
FIFA 实时比分更新现在也会带上点球大战总比分，淘汰赛行会用带新鲜度提示的 1-1（3-4 点球）样式展示，对阵图赛果标签也会匹配这种比分样式。
当 FIFA 官方 API 响应较慢时，实时数据接口现在会安全回退到已提交的备用数据，而不是显示 Vercel 超时页面。
淘汰赛比赛行在“某场胜者”等路径已经说明未决时，不再额外显示冗余的“预测”标签。
巴西对日本现在加入更具体的比赛故事，包括日本的防守压力、佐野海舟先开纪录，以及马丁内利最后阶段制胜。
历届世界杯赛果页现在也使用生成的故事速览，因此俄罗斯对埃及这样的2018存档比赛会提到乌龙球、久巴进球和萨拉赫点球，而不是泛泛的积分文案。
历届世界杯存档的“赛果”区现在与当前比赛保持一致：半粗比分句、进球时间线、项目符号故事事实，以及不会跳转到原始 GitHub 数据集的球员卡片提及。
历届世界杯存档的淘汰赛背景现在直接使用轮次名称，不再显示额外的“淘汰赛背景 / 存档”标题。

releases.title: Admin message banner
highlights: A clean light-grey admin note can now appear below the top navigation for time-boxed updates, then collapse smoothly after dismissal.
highlightsZh: 顶部导航下方现在可以显示简洁的浅灰色站内消息，用于有起止时间的临时更新，关闭后会平滑收起。

releases.title: Knockout path rankings
highlights: Knockout match info now removes inline flags from Previous and Next path copy, then adds compact FIFA ranking pills beside the referenced opponent countries.
Round of 32 group-round summaries now read with scores in the sentence, such as South Africa won 1-0 against South Korea, while the selected matchup teams avoid duplicate ranking pills.
Previous and Next path ranking pills now sit vertically centered, closer to the team name, and spaced away from following punctuation.

Projected knockout matchups now explain their predicted status in match details, keep confirmed source matches scheduled, and switch Final or third-place teams to real winners or runners-up once those results are in.
Completed knockout tiles now mute the finished card and losing team, keep the advancing team in color, and replace prediction pills with a compact final-score pill.
Completed knockout result notes now describe advancement and elimination, so Round of 32 and later matches no longer use group-stage points language.
Catch Up now opens immediately with skeleton rows, then fills in the news feed after the items finish rendering.
On mobile, tapping tournament percentage tooltips such as PAR 25% now opens only the tooltip, and tapping elsewhere closes it without jumping to the match page.
Mobile tournament bracket scrolling now stays pinned at the page top instead of exposing extra white space above the navigation.
Tournament outcome percentage pills now use three-letter codes like USA, TIE, and BIH instead of flag emoji labels.
highlightsZh: 淘汰赛比赛信息现在移除“上一轮”和“下一轮”路径文案里的行内旗帜，并在被提到的对手国家旁加入紧凑的FIFA排名标签。
32强的小组赛总结现在把比分直接写进句子，例如南非1-0击败韩国，同时当前对阵双方不会重复显示排名标签。
“上一轮”和“下一轮”路径里的排名标签现在会与周围句子文字垂直居中，对球队名更贴近，并与后面的标点留出间距。
预测中的淘汰赛对阵现在会在比赛详情中说明“预测”状态，已确认的来源比赛仍标为赛程，并在决赛或季军赛来源结果产生后自动切换为真实胜者或负者。
